jobs.description:
We are looking for a highly motivated Logistics Operator  for a leading company in the industrial sector. You will be responsible for ensuring smooth internal transport and efficient warehouse management.

 

Your mission;

You will play a crucial role in the efficient and safe processing of goods within the industrial site.

• You select and prepare the correct handling equipment, according to the characteristics of the products and the movement conditions.
• You welcome drivers to the industrial site, collecting and identifying documents from the administrative department.
• You are responsible for unloading or loading trucks.
• You move goods to the storage area and store the received raw materials in their appropriate locations.
• You check the condition of loads, identify anomalies, and pass them on to the relevant department.
• You carry out handling operations using handling equipment (such as forklifts, bulldozers, etc.).
• You ensure the order and cleanliness of the activity.
 

Your profile and skills;

• You are a true team player.
• You are eager to learn and always open to acquiring new skills.
• You are flexible and able to adapt easily to changing circumstances.
• You work in an organized manner and maintain oversight, even in a dynamic environment.
• Working safely comes naturally to you, and you strictly follow procedures.
• Experience with a forklift is a plus, although this is not a strict requirement.
• You have a good command of French and English , allowing you to communicate smoothly in the workplace.

jobs.occupation: Power Electronics and Motor Control Engineer
jobs.description:
Welcome to Traxial: Where big ideas start small (but mighty)
 

At Traxial, we are designing the next generation of high-performance, energy-efficient systems. We’re looking for a PE & Motor Control Engineer to join our innovative team and play a pivotal role in creating systems that push boundaries in robotics and industry.
 

This is what you’ll do: 
 
 

•  

Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to design, develop, and optimize high-efficiency power electronic & motor control systems. 
   
 

•  

Create detailed requirements and functional designs for power electronic circuits & motor controllers.. 
   
 

•  

Perform simulations, testing, and validation to ensure system performance meets all requirements. 
   
 

•  

Troubleshoot and resolve issues during the design, prototyping, and manufacturing phases. 
   
 

•  

Ensure products are compliant with relevant standards for power drive systems. 
   
 

•  

Stay informed about the latest trends and developments in power electronics in robotics & industrial applications. 
  

Who are we looking for?
 
 

•  

A Master's degree in Electrical Engineering or equivalent experience.
   
 

•  

Minimum of 3 years of experience in power electronics & circuit design.
   
 

•  

Strong knowledge of inverters and motor controllers.
   
 

•  

Experience with PCB design tools such as Kicad, Altium or equivalent.
   
 

•  

Experience with electronic circuit simulation software such as LTSpice or equivalent.
   
 

•  

Understanding of thermal management and electromagnetic compatibility (EMC).
   
 

•  

Previous experience in model-based design and/or FPGA platforms will be considered a plus.
   
 

•  

A team player with excellent problem-solving skills and a proactive mindset.
   
 

•  

Fluent in English, both written and spoken.

Internship description: 

Are you a motivated marketing or business student ready to make an impact at the world's leading brewer?  

Our Trade Marketing team bridges the gap between brand strategy and sales execution, driving success across diverse markets. We're looking for a proactive and ambitious student to join us and gain hands-on experience in one of the most dynamic and exciting industries. 

What will you do during the internship? 

• Support day-to-day operations in Trade Marketing, ensuring flawless execution of marketing campaigns in retail and Horeca.  
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver projects aligned with our brand and business goals.  
• Manage administrative tasks that keep the team running efficiently.  
• Gain exposure to the end-to-end marketing process at a global company. 
Internship duration:  

6 Months, starting in September/ October 2026    

Compensation:   

Unpaid (with potential for full-time employment post-internship)  

Learning opportunities: 

70% of your learning will come from on-the-job learning. As an intern, you'll get the chance to experience the real-life business whilst developing your skills - learning through experiencing different areas and building your own reputation.    

20% of your learning will come from mentorship programs, coaching, collaboration with key stakeholders & plenty of opportunities for feedback.  

10% of your learning will come from formal training, including workshops & online training courses. We will provide you with continuous opportunities to elevate your skills with access to free training sessions facilitated by AB InBev and LinkedIn Learning. 

  
 
What we're looking for: 

• You're a student. You're currently enrolled in a university program (this is a legal requirement for this position).  
• You're in Belgium. You live in or near Leuven, can work full-time for 6 months and can work from our office.  
• You're driven. You study Marketing, Business, or a related field and are excited to apply your skills in a real-world setting.  
• You're eager to grow. You're passionate about marketing, our brands, and the chance to build your career with us.  
• You're committed. You view this internship as more than a steppingstone¿it's an opportunity to prove yourself and earn a chance at a full-time position.  
• You're fluent in English. German will be a plus  
What we offer:   

• Experience at a global leader. AB InBev is the world's largest brewer, and you'll get to work on impactful projects in a fast-paced environment.   
• Growth opportunities. This is more than just an internship¿it's a chance to start your career with us. Outstanding interns will be considered for full-time roles post-graduation.   
• A dynamic, fun workplace. Join a team that values collaboration, innovation, and a shared love of our iconic brands.  
Why build your career with us:  

We recruit for mindset, ambition, cultural fit, and growth opportunities.   
   

UNIQUE CULTURE 

We are proud to be part of something bigger than ourselves and are passionate about building upon our company's long legacy. We believe in collaboration and candor, which results in a dynamic culture with open communication.     

BRANDS EVERYONE LOVES 

We are part of the collective, global history of beer. We are the proud makers of more than 500 iconic brands, from beloved international classics to local favorites.     

GROWTH OPPORTUNITIES 

Our people grow at the pace of their talent. We empower our people to learn, expand their perspectives, and unlock career growth.   

If this sounds like the incredible opportunity you've been waiting for, apply today.

• Define and implement validation and verification plans for new products and platforms.

Are you a real night owl and do you enjoy an active, hands-on job? Then we may have the perfect job for you! We are looking for a motivated Warehouse Operator to join the permanent night shift. Your tasks include:
 

 
• Receiving, checking and storing incoming goods
 
• Picking orders using voice picking and/or scanning
 
• Preparing orders accurately and on time for transport
 
• Loading and unloading trucks
 
• Moving goods using an electric pallet truck and/or reach truck
 
• Keeping the warehouse clean, organised and safe
 
• Following safety, hygiene and quality procedures (HACCP)
 
• Working in a chilled environment, including a freezer area 

Who are we looking for? You don't need years of experience for this position. Motivation and the right attitude are just as important! We are looking for someone who:
 

 
• Preferably has experience as a warehouse operator, although motivated candidates without experience are also welcome

• Can work independently as well as in a team

• Has experience with an electric pallet truck or reach truck (a valid certificate is a plus)
 
• Is comfortable working in a cold/freezer environment
 
• Is willing to work the permanent night shift
